warning: These are explicitly calibratable game rules, not measured predictions of protest, collapse, violence or state survival.

rule.stability_next: clip(0,100, stability_now + service_capacity_effect + support_effect + trust_effect - cost_of_living_pressure - unemployment_pressure - shortage_pressure - debt_crisis_pressure - repression_backfire)
rule.protest_trigger: stability < 35 for 7 consecutive days AND (cost_of_living_pressure + shortage_pressure) >= 18
rule.government_crisis_trigger: stability < 25 for 30 consecutive days OR trusted_governance < 20 with debt_service_stress > 25
rule.institutional_collapse_trigger: stability < 12 for 60 consecutive days AND service_capacity < 25
rule.recovery_trigger: service_capacity >= 40 AND trust >= 35 AND stability >= 30 for 30 days

validation: record every trigger input in audit snapshot
never label a synthetic threshold observed
